method: Synthetic JPEG fixtures passed through the unmodified extension/background.js infer function in a Node VM with live fetch and the real extension/core.js. All extension prompt, vision auto-detection, timeout and reply parsing behavior was retained. No Teams messages were sent.
limitations: The currently selected browser extension model was not confirmed.
User-attached screenshots were visually inspected in chat but were not submitted to Ollama. All API image tests used synthetic fixtures.
The 384x81 input was prepared using Pillow Lanczos resizing and JPEG quality 70 to approximate the extension capture dimensions and quality; browser canvas resampling can differ.
One inference per case; this is a basic diagnostic, not a statistical benchmark.
